provenance.what_this_is: node #1 as it stood at 2026-09-06 14:08 UTC, in the shape `planetai snapshot` writes. It carries 15-minute means, alert texts and sensor names — the keeper's own data. It carries no raw readings and never will.

transcribed.observations: values read off the same capture's screenshot; /observations itself was not captured. om-point.humidity_model is the one figure with no screenshot behind it: app/sources.py:365 does fetch it, nothing recorded it, and heat's region column needs it to be exercised at all.
transcribed.readings_1h: the room and ring 24 h shapes, read off the capture's chart. One sensor per distance carries them (sc-19880 for the room, bad-sc-19774 for the ring), so an aggregate over that distance reproduces the chart. Only pm25: the chart's apparent-temperature trace was transcribed as apparent, and the engine computes apparent from temp and humidity, so it is not replayable from this. Each row also carries the indoor, local and kind of its sensor, because the view the engine reads joins `sensors` for them and place_of needs all three.

reconstructed.actions: one row per /alerts.acted_at at stage `acted`. There is no GET /actions, and acted_at is min(ts) over acknowledged AND acted, so the distinction this fixture cannot carry is exactly the one app/issues/schema.py draws.
